properties.notes: Town centre office accommodation occupied by a bank at ground-floor level with the upper floors vacant. Offers opportunity for conversion of the first- and second-floors of the property, bringing redundant floorspace back into use. An increased yield would recognise the likelihood of an apartment scheme, providing residential accommodation within Berwick town centre is likely to be suitable given central location. Planning permission is now in place for conversion of the first and second floors into 6 flats (17/04396/FUL). The bank will remain in situ and is not impacted by this proposal. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next years.
